title: Entitlement
description: 200 answer of POST /v1/entitlement. entitled is true for trial, active, and grace, and for canceled until expires_at. pass and pass_expires_at are set only when entitled.

expires_at.description: When the subscription expired or will expire unless renewed, from Google. Null when Google gives none, as for a pending purchase.

pass.description: Sent as the x-paperboy-pass header and the pb_pass cookie on every request under /feed/ and /papers/.

pass_expires_at.description: The pass's exp: the earlier of expires_at and 48 hours from now.
